about: The branched-schema-key rules, as data. Prose is in
docs/claude/branched-schema-keys.md (written in the docs stage); the plan
today, and by the frontend test for the level checkboxes (stage level_default).
The idea: the tree is a default, the key set is the truth. Nothing here
refuses a key set; 'coherent' only decides defaults and what to offer.
trees: named declarations, one list per branch.
rule  : the SchemaTree method under test.
leaves(keys)           -> expect: [members with no descendant in keys]

cases.name: chain-of-item
cases.why: A chain is the key and its ancestors, not a list prefix.

cases.name: chain-of-person
cases.why: The empty-variable expectation owner: category and item are NOT person's ancestors.

cases.name: brand-has-two-children
cases.why: distribute from brand must ask for the target by name.

cases.name: item-has-no-child
cases.why: distribute from item: no child on its branch, today's error.

cases.name: linear-child
cases.why: A plain list behaves as before: the next key.

cases.name: leaves-of-cross-branch-set
cases.why: Two leaves: the set spans two branches.

cases.name: chain-is-a-chain
cases.why: Skipping a level is still one chain.

cases.name: two-branches-not-a-chain
cases.why: Different branches.

cases.name: empty-set-is-a-chain
cases.why: Nothing to disagree about.

cases.name: cross-branch-set-coherent-via-input
cases.why: A Purchase-like input carries both: the data shows the combination exists.

cases.name: cross-branch-set-incoherent-without-input
cases.why: No bound input names both.

cases.name: default-item-input
cases.why: One input: its own keys.

cases.name: default-item-and-person
cases.why: The union is incoherent: iterate the keys EVERY input carries.

cases.name: default-item-person-and-purchase
cases.why: The union lies inside Purchase's key set: coherent, all five.

cases.name: default-brand-and-item
cases.why: The union is a chain.

cases.name: default-no-inputs
cases.why: Nothing bound, nothing implied.

cases.name: default-linear-is-union
cases.why: Linear trees behave as before.

cases.name: default-ignores-a-dataset-level-input
cases.why: A keyless input broadcasts anywhere: it neither adds keys nor narrows the shared ones.

cases.name: offered-item-input
cases.why: Only the input's own branch.

cases.name: offered-person-input
cases.why: Only the input's own branch.

cases.name: offered-brand-only-input
cases.why: A brand-only input can be taken down either branch.

cases.name: offered-cross-branch-input
cases.why: Every key it carries; no firewall.

cases.name: offered-item-and-person-inputs
cases.why: Only what both can share, matching the default [brand].

cases.name: disabled-other-branch-after-tick
cases.why: Ticking category makes location and person incoherent for a brand-only input.

cases.name: nothing-disabled-with-cross-branch-input
cases.why: A bound cross-branch input makes any combination coherent.
